Caption: Cattle belonging to the United Cattle and Packing Company, Nevada: photographic print
Description: From the Nye County, Nevada Photograph Collection (PH-00221) -- Series VII. Other areas in Nye County -- Subseries VII.H. Reed Family (Kawich Mountains, Nevada). One year, the company had one herd with 4,000 head in it. Dated 1920 to 1929 by the archive.
